course.title: Water Resources Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
After how many days will you supply water to soil in order to ensure sufficient (10)   
irrigation of the given crop, if   
(i) Field capacity of the soil = 26%   
(ii) Permanent wilting point = 12%   
(iii) Dry density of soil = 1.3 gm/cc   
(iv) Effective depth of root zone = 60 cm   
(v) Daily consumptive use of given crop = 10 mm

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
